title: Input-to-state stability of chemical reaction networks with application to molecular computation
summary: Input-to-state stability (ISS) provides a useful tool for analyzing the robustness of time-varying chemical reaction networks (CRNs). This paper investigates the ISS property for CRNs in two cases: one is for weakly reversible CRNs with nonzero deficiency and multiple linkage classes, which is beyond the limit of existing results requesting a weakly reversible CRN to be zero-deficiency and single-linkage-class; the other is for non-weakly reversible CRNs by leveraging the notion of linear conjugacy.
